verdict.rationale: Linear documents a first-party "Write with Agent" action. The agent reviews changes made since the last update, checks the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for the user to refine, which delivers the core story. Shared skills for "drafting updates" add some reinforcement. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the drafting covers both project and initiative updates (the quote doesn't name the entity type), independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity

citations.quote: click Write with Agent to let Linear do it for you. The agent reviews changes made since the last update, checks messages in the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for you to refine.
Sharing a skill helps your team standardize recurring workflows like writing specs, running weekly planning, or drafting updates.
